title: Stability sync + responder review — Dec 10 2026
content:
Meeting: Stability sync + Responder review
Date: 2026-12-10 10:00 PT
Owner: Lina Park
Attendees: Marcus H., Priya N., Diego F., Sam R., On-call: rotation week (Dec 6–12) — responder: Priya Nair

Purpose:
- Weekly surface-level review of SLO trends, highlight any responder/comm runbook gaps, align on actions for customer-impacting events.

1) Current SLO snapshot (end-of-week numbers):
- API availability SLO (global): 99.95% target — rolling 7d = 99.86% (miss window 12/08 03:40–04:10 UTC)
- 99th latency (text-generation, p50/p95/p99 tokens): 48ms / 190ms / 430ms (spike correlates with 12/08 throttling)
- Embeddings throughput SLO: target 95% < 200ms — current 93.4%
- Error-rate by class: 0.83% client errors, 0.32% server 5xx (dominant 5xx = Redis timeout proxies)

2) Incident recap — "Throttling ripple" (INC-2026-11-78)
- Timeline summary: 12/08 03:37 UTC elevated queue depth on dedicated-gpu-pool-4; autoscaler mis-evaluated capacity due to stale metric from exporter; backpressure cascaded to host-level request queue then rate-limiter; visible client 429s and p99 latency spike; mitigated 03:58 UTC by manual pool scale and fallback to compatible model variant.
- Impact: ~22 minutes of customer 429s for mid-tier customers in us-west; no data exfiltration; delayed responses for queued requests.
- Root cause (current): exporter (gpu-agent v2.1.3) skipped a sample when instance went into transient DRAIN state — metrics ingestion gap led autoscaler to think utilization lower than reality.
- RCA status: draft, investigating exporter retry/backoff logic; engineering applied temporary guard: if exporter gap > 30s -> conservatively assume 80% utilization for autoscaler decision.
- Follow-ups (owners & due dates):
   * Fix gpu-agent sampling bug — PR opened (runtime/#2897) — owner: Diego F. — target 2026-12-14
   * Autoscaler change to fallback-to-historical on missing samples — owner: Marcus H. — target 2026-12-17
   * Post-incident customer e-mail draft for affected accounts — owner: Sam R. (CS) — target 2026-12-12

3) Responder / runbook review (action items from this meeting):
- Runbook gap identified: no explicit step to check exporter heartbeat vs autoscaler TTL. Add checklist "validate exporter stream health" and sequence of manual mitigation steps (scale pool, switch routing to fallback model variant, notify CS). Owner: Priya N. — due 2026-12-13.
- Playbook change: add a metric-derived alarm that triggers when K8s pod drain events coincide with exporter sample gaps > 15s. Owner: Lina P. — due 2026-12-15.
- On-call handoff note template updated to include: active experiments, model-variant rollouts, recent autoscaler rule changes (required because previous handoff lacked the autoscaler tweak context). Owner: Marcus H. — done 2026-12-10 (attached snippet).

4) Operational observations / small wins:
- New tracing tag added to gateway that surfaces "autoscaler-decision-reason" in spans — helped narrow cause faster during this incident. PR merged: runtime/#2894.
- Canary rollouts for quantized-2 variants reduced tail latency for low-memory instances in EU region — observed 12% p99 improvement in last 24h.

5) Outstanding SRE backlog / priorities (next 2 weeks):
- High: stabilize exporter sampling reliability (SRE-4321), autoscaler fallback logic (SRE-4330), add runbook alarm (SRE-4332).
- Med: expand synthetic canaries to include multi-model-fallback paths, add load-profile tests for dedicated pools (low-latency workloads).
- Low: tidy old runbook fragments in confluence (link: confluence:Runbook-Archive).

6) On-call handoff snapshot (for incoming responder Diego F., week Dec 13–19):
- Active tickets assigned: SRE-4321 (investigate exporter), SRE-4330 (autoscaler fallback), SRE-4308 (Redis proxy timeouts), INC-2026-11-78 (RCA in progress).
- Key configuration changes made this week: temporary autoscaler guard (k8s-config:autoscaler.guards.v1=true), tracing tag added, canary quantized-2 rollout.
- Contacts & escalation: 2nd-level infra: Priya Nair; runtime lead: Diego F.; product ops on-call: Sam R.; exec paging threshold still 95% of SLA breach for >30m.

7) Action items recap (quick list):
- Diego F: finalize gpu-agent fix + tests (due 12/14)
- Marcus H: implement autoscaler historical fallback + rollout plan (due 12/17)
- Priya N: update runbook & create alarm (due 12/13/15) [typo: due 12/13 runbook, 12/15 alarm]
- Sam R: customer comms draft and CS handover (due 12/12)
- Lina P: follow up with release engineering on canary coverage for dedicated pools (due 12/16)

Notes / misc:
- Suggestion from CS: temporarily lift rate-limits for priority enterprise accounts during autoscaler turbulence windows; needs legal/finance sign-off for billing exposure — added to follow-ups.
- Suggestion from runtime: bake a light-weight watchdog in exporter that emits a "health-sample" even under drain — low-risk; Diego to assess implementation cost.

Next meeting: Stability sync + responder review — 2026-12-17 10:00 PT
Rough agenda: RCA closeout, autoscaler rollout plan, canary coverage verification

End of notes.
